stories.h: Atmospheric river, gusty winds to hit Thanksgiving travel
stories.s: Forecasters expect the strongest system of the week Wednesday night into Thanksgiving: heavy rain, Puget Sound gusts above 40 mph, possible thunderstorms, scattered power outages and high-tide shoreline flooding.

stories.h: Washington sues HUD over mixed-status housing aid rule
stories.s: Washington joined a multistate lawsuit against a HUD rule ending prorated aid for mixed-status households. About 600 Washington families could lose help, and roughly 82,000 residents face new paperwork.

stories.h: Boeing wins 50-jet China order worth about $7.4 billion
stories.s: Xiamen Airlines, part of China Southern, ordered 50 single-aisle jets, mostly 737-8 MAXs. At list prices it is Boeing's biggest Chinese order in nearly a decade.

stories.h: Bird flu reaches Grant County dairy herd
stories.s: State agriculture officials confirmed bird flu in a Grant County dairy herd, bringing infected herds to 44 across Yakima, Benton and Grant counties since October. Pasteurized milk remains safe.

stories.h: Insurers paid $61M on last December's flood claims
stories.s: State data shows 1,056 residential claims and about $61.3 million paid after December 2025's floods. Whatcom, Skagit and King counties were hit hardest, and regulators say standard homeowner policies usually exclude floods.

talking.h: Darnold back at practice; start call comes Wednesday
talking.s: Sam Darnold practiced Monday for the first time in three weeks. Mike Macdonald plans to start him at San Francisco but says nothing is official until after Wednesday's practice.

talking.h: Fisch talks up Oregon ahead of rivalry trip
talking.s: Washington (7-4, 4-4 Big Ten) closes the regular season Saturday at Autzen Stadium against an Oregon team riding a five-game win streak.

coming.h: Wind Advisory, heavy rain Wednesday night into Thanksgiving
coming.s: A Wind Advisory starts 4 p.m. Wednesday. Expect heavy rain, gusts above 40 mph around Puget Sound, possible outages and mostly rain at the passes; Friday turns cooler.

coming.h: Skokomish River flood warning in Mason County
coming.s: Forecasters expect the river near Potlatch to pass flood stage Wednesday afternoon and crest near record levels overnight, swamping Skokomish Valley homes, farmland and roads including Highway 106 through Friday.

coming.h: Winter Storm Warning for Whatcom, Skagit Cascades
coming.s: The watch is now a warning from 7 p.m. Wednesday to 4 a.m. Friday, with 6 to 15 inches of snow and 35 mph gusts. Mountain travel could become very difficult or impossible.

coming.h: Thanksgiving tolls and WSDOT travel charts
coming.s: Weekend toll rates apply Thursday on SR 520, the SR 99 tunnel and SR 509. I-405 and SR 167 express lanes are free. WSDOT expects heavy I-90 delays and long ferry waits through Nov. 29.

coming.h: Huskies at Oregon in regular-season finale
coming.s: UW visits Autzen Stadium Saturday to close its regular season against the rival Ducks.
Seattle (6-4) takes on NFC West-leading San Francisco (9-1) on Sunday. Oddsmakers have the 49ers as 3.5-point favorites.
